main_text.p: terreni nobis præ oculis est, hic lucrum expectatur, ibi damnum metuitur, alibi in incertum eventum aliquid apparatur; omniaque eo tendunt, ut mundi nimis memores, vix Dei reminiscamur: cujus nos unius memoria occupare debebat, illiusque gratia cuncta quæ facimus facere. Hinc parva Spiritus sancti in nobis consolatio, illuminatio vero in plerisque adeo nulla, ut pro fabulis & phantasmatibus habeatur, quicquid de illa dicitur. Alia longè fuit animorum constitutio primis Ecclesiæ initijs, aliaque futura est ijs, qui fundamenta domus Dei inter incredulos jacient: de nullo enim alio lucro, quam æterna animarum salute; de nullo damno, quam Dei offensione cogitabunt: omniaque eo dirigent, ut non in incertum laborasse, sed immarcescibilem æternæ gloriæ coronam sub oculis positam, strenuè decertando, sibi comparare voluisse videantur: militem generosum secuti, qui dum in acie consistit, agri & nummorum oblitus, solam sibi victoriam proponit. Volutentur alij in mundi hujus delicijs: gaudeant nugacibus mortis insidiis, varioq; suave colorati anguis ludibrio delectentur: prætiosum tempus, cultui Dei præscriptum, perpetuis impofturis, subsan-natio-

page.notes: Small dark marks in the left margin beside several lines (e.g. near "memores" and "delicijs") and a stain at the lower left look like specks or show-through, not printed text, so they are left out. The last word is hyphenated across the page break ("subsan-" / "natio-"); the second half is printed at the foot of the page and is included as printed. Doubtful readings: "prætiosum" and "impofturis" are copied as they appear on the scan and may be misread. The text reads "laborasse" as printed. The running head is taken from the printed header.
